meta.title: 面试10分钟就结束？邀约时先问清这5问
meta.title_en: Interview Lasted 10 Minutes? Ask These 5 Questions First

scenes.title_en: A ten-minute interview means a mismatch
scenes.context: 讲者指出十几分钟就结束的面试意味着岗位不匹配，而根因是 HR 不专业。
sentences: 出席2小时，面试10分钟，你是不是也有过类似比较惨痛的面试情况呢？
Two hours of commuting for a ten-minute interview — have you ever had a painful experience like that?
出席2小时：two hours of commuting
如果说你的面试十几分钟就结束掉了，那只能说明你跟应聘的岗位是明显不匹配的。
If your interview wraps up in ten-something minutes, it can only mean you're a poor fit for the role.
明显不匹配：a poor fit for the role
导致这种情况发生的原因多半是HR不专业，他记不清楚用人部门选人的基本要求。
Mostly it's an unprofessional recruiter who can't recall the hiring team's basic requirements.
用人部门：the hiring team
paraphrase: 面试时间短≠你不行→是岗位不匹配
A short interview isn't your failure — it's a mismatch.
根因是HR不专业→怪不到你头上
It's usually the recruiter's fault, not yours.
scenes.speak: Two hours of commuting for a ten-minute interview — have you ever had a painful experience like that? If your interview wraps up in ten-something minutes, it can only mean you're a poor fit for the role. Mostly it's an unprofessional recruiter who can't recall the hiring team's basic requirements.

scenes.context: 讲者给出邀约五问中的前三问：公司、岗位、匹配度。
sentences: 第一问问公司：这家公司属于什么行业、做什么业务、规模怎么样、什么时候成立的。
First, ask about the company: what industry, what they do, how big they are, and when they were founded.
属于什么行业：what industry they're in
第二问问岗位：招什么岗位、为什么招这个岗位、工作内容是什么、胜任要求是什么。
Second, ask about the role: what it is, why it's open, what the job involves, and what they expect.
胜任要求：what they expect / requirements
第三问问匹配度：您看我的简历哪些方面是跟岗位比较匹配的呢？
Third, ask about fit: which parts of my resume do you think match the role?
匹配度：how well I fit
paraphrase: Ask about the company to form a first impression.
问岗位与匹配度→判断靠谱与机会
Ask about the role and fit to gauge quality and odds.
scenes.speak: First, ask about the company: what industry, what they do, how big they are, and when they were founded. Second, ask about the role: what it is, why it's open, what the job involves, and what they expect. Third, ask about fit: which parts of my resume do you think match the role?

scenes.context: 讲者给出五问的后两问：业务主管是否看过简历、福利条件，提醒避免现场才发现单休。
sentences: 第四问问主管：业务主管有看过我的简历吗？
Fourth, ask about the hiring manager: have they actually seen my resume?
业务主管：the hiring manager
保险起见还是要确认一下业务主管是不是已经评估过自己的简历了。
To be safe, make sure the hiring manager has already reviewed your resume.
评估过简历：review the resume
千万不要傻乎乎地跑到面试现场，才发现原来是单休。
Don't show up at the office only to discover it's a six-day workweek.
单休：a six-day workweek
paraphrase: 技术岗要确认主管看过简历→不被HR看懂与否耽误
For technical roles, confirm the manager has seen it so nothing gets lost.
福利问清→别现场才发现落差
Clarify the perks so there are no surprises on site.
scenes.speak: Fourth, ask about the hiring manager: have they actually seen my resume? To be safe, make sure the hiring manager has already reviewed your resume. Don't show up at the office only to discover it's a six-day workweek.

practice: Could you tell me more about the role and its responsibilities?
Which parts of my background do you see as a strong match?
表达「确认主管看过简历」
Has the hiring manager had a chance to review my resume?
Is the position five days a week, and what's the compensation range?
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Attend for two hours, interview for ten minutes.
✓ 地道说法：Two hours of commuting for a ten-minute interview.
用 commuting 表达「出席往返」，更自然。
✕ 直译腔：Why do you recruit this position?
✓ 地道说法：Why is this role open?
role 代替 position 更口语，why is it open 更地道。
✕ 直译腔：Which aspects of my resume are matched with the job?
✓ 地道说法：Which parts of my background match the role?
parts of my background 比 aspects are matched 自然得多。
✕ 直译腔：Don't be foolishly run to the interview place.
✓ 地道说法：Don't show up at the office only to find out it's a six-day week.
show up + only to find out 是地道口语表达。
shifts: 有面试就跑，跑完才发现不合适
邀约时先问清五问再决定去不去
面试时间短就自我怀疑
知道这是岗位不匹配的信号，不是自己不行
用五问自己做前置筛选
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「音频的岗位」校正为「应聘的岗位」，「三十种无效面试」校正为「三种（这类）无效面试」，「这种底四问」校正为「这五问」，「生育内要求」校正为「胜任要求」，「有记忆过的帮助」校正为「有利于帮助」，「工作低点」校正为「工作地点」，「双修」校正为「双休」，「生片室」校正为「面试现场」，「面的寂寞」校正为「面得稀里糊涂」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
